```python
import openpyxl

def extract_green_cells(path):
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path)
    ws = wb.active
    greens = []
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            fill = cell.fill
            color = None
            # Try direct fgColor
            if fill and fill.fgColor and fill.fgColor.type == 'rgb':
                color = fill.fgColor.rgb
            # Some files may store in start_color
            elif fill and fill.start_color and fill.start_color.type == 'rgb':
                color = fill.start_color.rgb
            if color and color.upper() in {"FF00FF00", "FF008000", "FF00FF99"}:
                greens.append((cell.row, cell.column))
    return greens

cells = extract_green_cells("/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/5cfb274c-0207-4aa7-9575-6ac0bd95d9b2.xlsx")
print(cells)
```
